channel.title: Adeeb Noor — Research Updates
channel.description: Curated recent research and public scholarly updates by Adeeb Noor.

item.title: Context-aware AI assistance reduces diagnostic error in chest X-ray interpretation
item.description: With Redhwan Nour, this study evaluates selective, context-aware AI assistance for chest X-ray interpretation rather than assuming AI should always be shown.

item.title: Ontology-Enhanced Deep Learning for Mechanistic Prediction of Drug-Drug Interactions: A Clinically Interpretable Framework
item.description: A clinically interpretable DDI framework combining ontology-based embeddings with deep learning to predict pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic interaction mechanisms.

item.title: BioUNER: A Benchmark Dataset for Clinical Urdu Named Entity Recognition
item.description: A biomedical Urdu named-entity recognition benchmark built from 153K annotated tokens and evaluated with classical, deep-learning and multilingual transformer baselines.

item.title: Optimizing electric vehicle energy consumption prediction through machine learning and ensemble approaches
item.description: A machine-learning study of EV energy-consumption prediction using real-world data, hyperparameter optimization and a stacking ensemble.

item.title: FCIT announces Adeeb Noor's promotion to Full Professor
item.description: The Faculty of Computing and Information Technology publicly announced the Scientific Council decision promoting Adeeb Noor to Full Professor in the Information Technology Department.
